free_text: The patient is a 70-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 8.8 ng/mL and a biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2). MRI identified a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left apex, with a clinical T stage of cT1c. The management assessment indicates that individual treatment benefit and preferences require clinical review, noting a previous attempt was invalid due to the Gleason score.
